comment: Independent allmain.c witness for init_sound_disp_gamewindows() calling status_initialize(FALSE) (allmain.c:720-721) before the restore-or-new-game branch: a Tourist saves in the first segment; the second segment restores the game and turns on the 'time' option with O, so options.c optfn_boolean() calls status_initialize(REASSESS_ONLY) (options.c:5349-5350), which botl.c:1697 permits only after the full initialization. The seeds, dates and keys were chosen for this case.
